blocks.html: HPM shall be transported to fabrication areas through enclosed piping or tubing systems that comply with Section 415.11.6, through service corridors complying with Section 415.11.3, or in exit access corridors as permitted in the exception to Section 415.11.2. The handling or transporting of HPM within service corridors shall comply with the New York City Fire Code.
